title: Gen AI Engineer Python

title: Python Developer
jobDescription: We are looking for a skilled Python Backend Developer with strong expertise in Core Python and modern backend technologies. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in designing, developing, and maintaining scalable backend applications, REST APIs, and microservices. The candidate should be passionate about writing clean, efficient, and maintainable code while working in a collaborative Agile environment.  ​ Roles and Responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend applications using Python. Build high-performance RESTful APIs and backend services. Develop and maintain microservices-based applications. Write clean, reusable, and efficient code following best coding practices. Design and optimize database schemas, queries, and transactions. Integrate third-party APIs and external services. Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize application performance. Write unit and integration tests to ensure code quality. Collaborate with frontend developers, QA engineers, product managers, and Dev Ops teams. Participate in code reviews and contribute to architecture discussions. Technical Skills Strong proficiency in Core Python . Hands-on experience with Fast API, Flask, or Django. Good understanding of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) and design patterns. Experience with Git and version control systems. Knowledge of Docker and containerization. Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines. Strong debugging and problem-solving skills.

title: Senior Content Writer
jobDescription: We’re seeking a wordsmith who can translate deep technical and domain knowledge into compelling content across multiple formats. You would own the strategy, research, and execution of content that speaks to decision-makers, tech leaders, and product stakeholders. Your work will directly support our positioning as a strategic engineering partner and AI consultant in the digital space. Roles and Responsibilities Own long-form content creation for blogs, case studies, whitepapers, and thought leadership pieces. Convert technical briefs and domain-specific discussions into clear, business-focused narratives. Collaborate closely with Sales, Marketing, and Delivery teams to identify content opportunities. Craft compelling copy for presentations, product marketing, internal campaigns, and microsites. Repurpose long-form content into microcopy for social media, carousels, and emailers. Maintain Coditas’ tone across all assets. Keep up with industry trends to ensure content relevance. Edit and review the works of junior team members to maintain quality and consistency. Collaborate with the Content Lead in building campaigns and content calendars. Skills and Qualifications 4–6 years of experience writing B2B tech content (agency or in-house). Exceptional command over verbal and written English, with an eye for structure, clarity, and tone. Strong research and synthesis skills (you know how to turn raw info into sharp insights). Experience writing content for consulting-level or strategic positioning (not just SEO blogs). Proficiency working with Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Slides) and Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Power Point). Experience with keyword research and SEO-based practices. Strong interpersonal skills and proactive approach to collaborating with colleagues and stakeholders. The ability to understand and ask the right questions to subject matter experts. Knowledge of or experience working with the IT industry, specifically around software development. Hands-on experience with LLMs (Chat GPT, Gemini, Perplexity, etc.); The knack to make your writing unique in an era of Generative AI-driven content.

title: Associate Data Quality Analyst
jobDescription: We are seeking an Associate Data Quality Analyst – Intern to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for analyzing, verifying, and resolving data quality issues within financial and capital markets data. Additionally, you will be tasked with analyzing various reports and identifying discrepancies in the data. This role offers an opportunity to work with tools such as My SQL, AWS, and Python for data extraction and identifying data quality issues. You will also collaborate with vendors and internal stakeholders daily to resolve discrepancies.  Roles and Responsibilities Take initiatives to improve data quality across multiple financial market data APIs.   Proactively identify data quality and coverage issues, working closely with internal stakeholders and external vendors to resolve them.   Assist in identifying and resolving data quality issues across various datasets.   Liaise regularly with senior team members, such as Data Quality Analysts, Senior Data Quality Analysts, and Team Leads, to address emerging issues.   Investigate discrepancies in data using diagnostic tools and provide appropriate solutions.  Correct erroneous data (such as reference, pricing, corporate actions, etc.) using corrective APIsand tools, following best practices.   Analyze data quality issues in various areas within capital market data.  Required Skills   Fresh graduates with a strong passion for investment banking and finance domain are encouraged to apply.   Basic understanding of financial instruments, markets, and corporate finance concepts.   Quick learner with the ability to grasp new tools, processes, and concepts efficiently.   Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.   Detail-oriented with a focus on maintaining data accuracy and integrity.   Proficient in Microsoft Excel; exposure to financial modeling or databases is a plus.   Good communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively in a team environment.  Bachelor’s degree in Commerce or Finance MBA or a relevant master’s degree in Finance preferred.
